budget's metering-history casts are checked and left alone or fixed with a stated reason
context: Observed 2026-10-15 in the C0 reuse check of the Snowflake trial-exit campaign.
description: `_project/analysis/snowflake-trial-exit/snowflake_campaign.py statement-history` calls `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY(END_TIME_RANGE_START => '<since>'::TIMESTAMP_TZ, ...)`. Snowflake rejects it: "invalid type [TIMESTAMP_TZ(9)] for parameter 'END_TIME_RANGE_START'". The function takes TIMESTAMP_LTZ. A scratch copy using `::TIMESTAMP_LTZ` ran correctly on 2026-10-15.
